title: Recent advances in acute pain management: understanding the mechanisms of acute pain, the prescription of opioids, and the role of multimodal pain therapy
summary: Narrative review of acute pain biology, opioid prescribing considerations, and multimodal analgesia. Useful background on why discharge prescribing is often discussed alongside non-opioid strategies.

title: The design and methods of genetic studies on acute and chronic postoperative pain in patients after total knee replacement
authors: Belfer I, Greco CM, Lokshin A, Vulakovich K, Landsittel D, Dai F, et al. (incl. Chelly JE)
summary: Describes study design for genetic analyses of acute and persistent pain after knee replacement. Highlights patient-level variation beyond average pain scores in perioperative research.

title: Integration of pain score and morphine consumption in analgesic clinical studies
authors: Dai F, Silverman DG, Chelly JE, Li J, Belfer I, Qin L
summary: Discusses combining patient-reported pain with opioid consumption when judging analgesic effect in trials. Relevant to outcome measurement when pain alone does not capture medication use.

title: The use of intravenous infusion or single dose of low-dose ketamine for postoperative analgesia: a review of the current literature
authors: Jouguelet-Lacoste J, La Colla L, Schilling D, Chelly JE
summary: Review of perioperative low-dose ketamine regimens and reported analgesic effects. Context for opioid-sparing options in acute postoperative care.

title: Large reduction in opioid prescribing by a multipronged behavioral intervention after major urologic surgery
authors: Jacobs BL, Rogers D, Yabes JG, Bandari J, Ayyash OM, Maganty A, et al. (incl. Chelly JE)
summary: Reports lower post-discharge opioid prescribing after a structured behavioral intervention in urologic surgery. An independent research result, not an OpAIx product outcome.

title: Continuous femoral blocks improve recovery and outcome of patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty
authors: Chelly JE, Greger J, Gebhard R, Coupe K, Clyburn TA, Buckle R, et al.
summary: Clinical study linking continuous femoral nerve blockade to recovery measures after total knee arthroplasty. Example of regional analgesia affecting function, not only pain scores.

title: Pain, analgesic use, and patient satisfaction with spinal versus general anesthesia for hip fracture surgery: a randomized clinical trial
authors: Neuman MD, Feng R, Ellenberg SS, Sieber F, Sessler DI, Magaziner J, et al. (REGAIN Investigators, incl. Chelly JE)
summary: Large randomized trial comparing anesthesia techniques for hip fracture surgery on pain, analgesic use, and satisfaction. Illustrates rigorous measurement of perioperative patient-reported outcomes.

title: Impact of peripheral nerve block with low dose local anesthetics on analgesia and functional outcomes following total knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study
authors: Liu Q, Chelly JE, Williams JP, Gold MS
summary: Retrospective analysis of low-dose peripheral nerve blocks and postoperative analgesia and mobility after knee replacement. Adds real-world context on blocks and functional recovery.
